description: This file defines classes and functions for handling JSON-RPC messaging within the WPEFramework core library. It includes message structures, error handling, context management, and a handler class for registering and invoking RPC methods, supporting versioning and different method signatures.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC message, including fields for version, id, method, parameters, result, and error information.

classes.name: Message::Info
classes.description: Encapsulates error information with code, message, and data fields.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Holds contextual information for RPC calls, such as channel ID, sequence number, and token.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Manages registration, invocation, and management of RPC methods, supporting versioning and different method signatures.

classes.name: Handler::EventIterator
classes.description: Iterates over registered events in the handler.

methods.name: Message::SetError
methods.description: Sets the error code and message based on a framework error code.

methods.name: Message::Clear
methods.description: Resets the message fields to default values.

methods.name: Message::Callsign
methods.description: Extracts the callsign from the designator string.

methods.name: Message::Method
methods.description: Extracts the method name from the designator string.

methods.name: Message::FullMethod
methods.description: Extracts the full method name from the designator string.

methods.name: Message::VersionedFullMethod
methods.description: Extracts the versioned full method name from the designator string.

methods.name: Message::Version
methods.description: Extracts the version number from the designator string.

methods.name: Message::VersionAsString
methods.description: Returns the version as a string from the designator string.

methods.name: Message::Index
methods.description: Extracts the index part from the designator string.

methods.name: Handler::Register
methods.description: Registers a new RPC method with the handler.

methods.name: Handler::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a registered RPC method with given parameters.
